composition: Use high-angle or low-angle perspective; avoid flat eye-level shots except for symmetrical group lineups.
Place the primary character dead-center, occupying 60-70% of the vertical frame.
Incorporate a dynamic foreground element (e.g., fanned cash, phone, cigar, or car door) within the bottom 30% of the frame to establish depth.
Use strong diagonal lines from background elements like staircases, car silhouettes, or skyscrapers to guide the eye to the subject.
typographie: Integrate text directly onto clothing graphics (e.g., 'sp5der' or 'TRAPSTAR') using stylized gothic, bubbly cartoon, or bold sans-serif fonts.
Keep generated brand text flat and sharp, matching the fabric's perspective and folds.
Limit standalone floating text to a single glowing, stylized sans-serif word (e.g., 'SMOOKY') centered at the top edge.
coherence_personnages: Pose characters with a confident, relaxed, or intimidating attitude: hands holding cash, gesturing, or holding weapons in a low guard.
Dress characters in premium streetwear (hoodies, denim tube tops, knit vests, graphic tees) layered with heavy chrome/gold jewelry and designer sunglasses.
Render skin with a clean, semi-realistic 3D game engine finish, showing detailed tattoos and soft-painted textures.
Frame shots as vertical medium close-ups (waist-up) or dynamic full-body poses next to luxury assets like sports cars or music studio desks.
lumiere: Apply low-key night lighting with a strong colored ambient ground glow (magenta, blue, or red) reflecting on surfaces.
Use soft, diffused overhead key lights (streetlights or studio ring lights) to cast gentle highlights on hair, shoulders, and caps.
Incorporate sharp, high-contrast side-lighting for daytime scenes to create deep shadows and metallic glints on jewelry.
etalonnage: Nocturnal/Urban: Deep blacks (#0B0B0D) paired with vibrant neon accents like magenta (#D921B3) or electric blue (#7CB2E8).
Daytime/Cartel: Warm, desaturated tones with sandy beige (#E5D3B3), olive green (#607D50), and rich gold (#D4AF37).
High-Contrast: Monochromatic bases (#111111, #FFFFFF) slashed with aggressive crimson red (#D11A2A).
effets: Apply heavy film grain and subtle chromatic aberration to mimic a gritty CCTV or phone camera aesthetic.
Add soft lens bloom on glowing screens, neon strips, and metallic jewelry reflections.
Introduce volumetric smoke wisps from cigars or cigarettes to enhance the atmospheric depth.
logo: Embed logos naturally as faded prints on props (e.g., paper cups, phone cases) rather than overlaying them as flat watermarks.
interdits: Avoid flat, shadowless indoor lighting that makes 3D models look low-poly or unfinished.
Do not use clean, solid-color vector backgrounds; backgrounds must be atmospheric, blurred urban scenes or textured walls.
Avoid stiff, T-pose-like symmetry; characters must have relaxed, asymmetrical hand poses or tilted head angles.
